title: PostgreSQL JSON and structured alternatives
brief: Use PostgreSQL JSONB where it fits the facts, validation and update boundary.
outcomes: Choose columns, related rows and JSON documents deliberately
Match JSON operators and indexes while preserving data rules
entry: Row meaning, values and PostgreSQL index contracts.

heading.title: A document inside a row
heading.brief: Use proposed product attributes for optional shape; contrast these with order lines that have independent identity and relationships.

heading.title: Values and validation
heading.brief: Distinguish missing keys, JSON null and SQL NULL; choose types and checks for attributes the application relies upon.

heading.title: Queries and indexes
heading.brief: Compare containment, path extraction and expression indexes on the same catalogue question; inspect the supported operator and actual access path.

heading.title: Change boundaries
heading.brief: Follow concurrent changes to one product document, write cost and migration to columns or related rows; avoid assuming path syntax makes a physical partial update.
